15:72.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
, in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly.

15:73.text: overtook them at the time of sunrise.

15:74.text: upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay.

15:75.text: Surely! In this are signs for those who see
(or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allâh)

15:76.text: (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now)

15:77.text: Surely! Therein is indeed a sign for the believers.

15:78.text: And the Dwellers in the Wood
And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan
was sent by Allâh), were also Zâlimûn

15:79.text: So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see.

15:80.text: And verily, the dwellers of Al-Hijr

15:81.text: And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them.

15:82.text: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains

15:83.text: overtook them in the early morning
(of the fourth day of their promised punishment days)

15:84.text: And all that they used to earn availed them not.

15:85.text: And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming, so overlook
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
[This was before the ordainment of Jihâd - holy fighting in Allâh’s cause]

15:86.text: Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.

15:87.text: And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathâni

15:88.text: Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them
, nor grieve over them. And lower your wings for the believers

15:89.text: (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)

15:90.text: As We have sent down on the dividers,
